keywords.alloc: Allocate a native buffer into a variable by byte count or interop type size.
keywords.as: Rename a CLR alias or required export in the current scope.
keywords.bind: Attach native function bindings to a required native module.
keywords.callconv: Override the native calling convention for a bound export.
keywords.catch: Handle a thrown value or runtime failure.
keywords.class: Define a ToSh class with properties, constructors, and methods.
keywords.continue: Skip the rest of the current loop iteration.
keywords.enum: Define a named enum with symbolic members and optional underlying numeric storage.
keywords.export: Export a module declaration or environment variable.
keywords.for: Iterate over pipeline output or another enumerable source.
keywords.from: Select a source file or module in selective `require` forms.
keywords.func: Define a function. Use `func name(args) { ... }` or `func name => command`.
keywords.global: Publish a declaration to the session-wide scope.
keywords.if: Run a block when a condition evaluates to true.
keywords.match: Use `match (<value>) { pattern => result; default => fallback }` for expression-style branching, or `match <regex> ...` as the regex command.
keywords.module: Define a named ToSh module object with its own lexical scope.
keywords.nameof: Return the name of a variable or member path.
keywords.native: In `require native`, load a native shared library for binding and invocation.
keywords.new: Construct a CLR object, ToSh named type, or shell collection type like `new list<String>(...)`.
keywords.out: Mark a native binding parameter as output-only and return its updated value after the call.
keywords.prop: Declare a class property, getter, setter, or computed member.
keywords.record: Define a named data shape with positional construction, defaults, and structural equality.
keywords.ref: Mark a native binding parameter as by-reference so the call can read and update it.
keywords.require: Load a `.tosh` module, `.dll`, or `.csproj` once per session and import names lexically.
keywords.return: Exit the current function or script early.
keywords.shy: Keep a declaration in the current lexical scope, or hide a class member from public inspection and external access.
keywords.static: Mark a class member as belonging to the class instead of an instance.
keywords.switch: Legacy statement-style value matching with `case` blocks.
keywords.until: Repeat a block until a condition becomes true.
keywords.using: Import CLR namespaces or create CLR aliases in the current lexical scope.
keywords.var: Declare a variable. Reference it later as `$name`.
keywords.while: Repeat a block while a condition remains true.

specialVariables.$tosh: The live ToSh runtime namespace root for config, script state, shell/session state, and host metadata.
specialVariables._: The current pipeline item in `where`, `each`, and similar contexts.

builtins.all: Returns true if every pipeline value matches the predicate.
builtins.alloc: Allocates a native unmanaged buffer by byte size or interop type.
builtins.any: Returns true if any pipeline value matches the predicate.
builtins.append-file: Appends plain text to a file, creating it when needed.
builtins.apropos: Searches Tosh help topics with fuzzy matching.
builtins.as-file: Materializes values into a temporary file and returns it as a file system entry.
builtins.assert: Asserts that a condition is true; throws a diagnostic error if it is false.
builtins.avg: Averages numeric, storage size, or timespan values.
builtins.back: Goes back to the previous directory in the stack.
builtins.basename: Returns the file name portion of each path.
builtins.call: Invokes an instance or static CLR method.
builtins.call-method: Invokes a method by dynamic name.
builtins.cast: Casts pipeline values to a CLR type, including constructed generic collection types.
builtins.cat: Reads one or more files or piped text sources and emits their contents.
builtins.cd: Changes the current directory for the Tosh session.
builtins.chunk: Groups pipeline items into fixed-size batches.
builtins.clone: Creates a shallow copy of an object.
builtins.close: Closes one or more managed file or server handles.
builtins.collect: Collects all pipeline items into a single list.
builtins.compose: Composes two or more callables into a single callable that chains them left-to-right.
builtins.constructors: Lists constructors for CLR types, ToSh classes, and shell collection types.
builtins.converge: Applies a callable to the seed repeatedly until two consecutive results are equal, then yields that stable value.
builtins.copy-to: Copies the remaining contents of one managed file handle into another compatible handle.
builtins.count: Counts the number of objects in the current pipeline.
builtins.curry: Converts a fixed-arity callable into a curried callable value.
builtins.cut: Extracts character or delimited fields from text.
builtins.date: Creates, parses, and adjusts date/time values.
builtins.del-prop: Removes a property from a dynamic record.
builtins.describe-type: Describes CLR types, ToSh named types, or shell collection types.
builtins.df: Returns mounted file system usage information.
builtins.dirname: Returns the directory portion of each path.
builtins.dirs: Shows or manages the directory stack.
builtins.du: Returns disk usage information for files and directories.
builtins.each: Executes a block or callable once for each input object.
builtins.echo: Emits its arguments as pipeline objects.
builtins.env: Lists, queries, sets, or unsets environment variables. Runs nested commands with temporary environment changes when a command follows.
builtins.events: Lists, inspects, and manages event handlers.
builtins.exec: Replace the current ToSh process with an external command.
builtins.exit: Requests the current Tosh session to exit.
builtins.export: Exports a Tosh value to the process environment.
builtins.filter: Filters pipeline values with a callable value or block predicate.
builtins.find-index: Returns the 0-based index of the first pipeline value matching the predicate, or -1 if none match.
builtins.findmnt: Wraps the system findmnt utility, returning typed mounted-filesystem objects for JSON-backed invocations.
builtins.first: Returns the first object or first N objects from the pipeline.
builtins.flat-map: Transforms each pipeline value with a callable or block then flattens the results.
builtins.flatten: Explicitly expands enumerable pipeline values by one level.
builtins.flush: Flushes one or more managed file handles.
builtins.forward: Goes forward to the next directory in the stack.
builtins.free: Returns system memory and swap usage.
builtins.frequencies: Counts occurrences of each distinct value in the pipeline.
builtins.get: Gets a member, projects fields, or retrieves an item by index.
builtins.get-methods: Lists method names for an object or ToSh class.
builtins.get-prop: Gets a property value by dynamic name.
builtins.get-props: Lists property names for an object.
builtins.grep: Searches text input with a regular expression or literal pattern.
builtins.group-by: Groups pipeline values by a member path, block, or callable.
builtins.group-while: Groups consecutive items while the predicate holds.
builtins.guid: Creates, parses, formats, and inspects GUID values.
builtins.has-method: Checks whether an object or ToSh class has the named method.
builtins.has-prop: Checks whether an object has the named property.
builtins.hash: Computes hashes for text input or files.
builtins.head: Returns the first objects or first text lines.
builtins.help: Shows searchable Tosh help for commands, language topics, CLR types, and externals.
builtins.history: Shows, searches, expands, runs, deletes, saves, reloads, or clears shell history.
builtins.history-search: Searches shell history entries by text.
builtins.hostnamectl: Wraps hostnamectl, returning a structured host-status object for supported JSON-backed status queries.
builtins.http: Sends HTTP requests and returns structured response objects or decoded bodies.
builtins.id: Returns current user and group identity information.
builtins.ignore: Consumes and discards all pipeline input.
builtins.inspect: Inspects piped CLR objects inline, or returns legacy flat output with --flat.
builtins.interleave: Alternates items from the pipeline with items from another sequence.
builtins.invoke: Invokes a callable value such as a lambda or function object.
builtins.ip: Wraps the system ip utility, returning typed objects for supported JSON-backed subcommands.
builtins.is-dir: Checks whether each path is a directory.
builtins.is-file: Checks whether each path is a file.
builtins.is-link: Checks whether each path is a symbolic link.
builtins.iterate: Generates an infinite sequence by repeatedly applying a callable to the previous result, starting from a seed. Pair with 'take' or 'take-while' to bound the output.
builtins.join-lines: Joins input values into a single text value.
builtins.journalctl: Wraps journalctl, returning typed journal-entry objects for supported JSON-backed query invocations.
builtins.kill: Stops a ToSh background job or operating-system process.
builtins.last: Returns the last object or last N objects from the pipeline.
builtins.length: Returns the current stream length for one or more managed file handles.
builtins.lines: Splits text input into individual lines.
builtins.ln: Creates hard links or symbolic links.
builtins.load-assembly: Loads a .NET assembly from disk into the current process.
builtins.loginctl: Wraps loginctl, returning typed session/user/seat rows and structured login property sets for supported queries.
builtins.lsblk: Wraps the system lsblk utility, returning typed block-device objects for JSON-backed invocations.
builtins.lscpu: Wraps the system lscpu utility, returning typed CPU summary, topology, and cache objects for JSON-backed invocations.
builtins.lsfd: Wraps the system lsfd utility, returning typed open-file-descriptor objects for JSON-backed invocations.
builtins.lsipc: Wraps the system lsipc utility, returning structured IPC resource and limit records for JSON-backed invocations.
builtins.map: Transforms each pipeline value with a callable value or block.
builtins.match: Matches text with a regular expression and returns shell record objects.
builtins.members: Lists public members for CLR types or pipeline objects.
builtins.methods: Lists public methods for CLR types or pipeline objects.
builtins.mkdir-temp: Creates a temporary directory and returns it as a file system entry.
builtins.mv: Moves or renames files and directories.
builtins.native-free: Frees one or more native buffers allocated by native-alloc.
builtins.native-read: Reads a C string, byte range, or native scalar/struct-layout value from native memory.
builtins.native-write: Writes a C string, byte sequence, or struct-layout value into native memory.
builtins.networkctl: Wraps networkctl, returning typed network-link rows for supported list queries.
builtins.new: Constructs a new CLR object, ToSh named type, or shell collection.
builtins.none: Returns true if no pipeline values match the predicate.
builtins.offset-of: Returns the unmanaged field offset for a sequential or explicit-layout struct.
builtins.open-file: Opens one or more files as managed text or binary handles.
builtins.parse: Parses text input with a regular expression into shell record objects.
builtins.partial: Binds leading arguments to a callable and returns a new callable value.
builtins.partition: Splits pipeline values into two lists based on a predicate: [matches, non-matches].
builtins.pick: Gets a member, projects fields, or retrieves an item by index.
builtins.ping: Pings a host and returns typed reply objects.
builtins.position: Returns the current stream position for one or more managed file handles.
builtins.prompt-dir: Returns the current directory as a styled prompt segment.
builtins.prompt-duration: Returns the last command duration as a styled prompt segment.
builtins.prompt-exit: Returns the last non-zero exit code as a styled prompt segment.
builtins.prompt-git: Returns git branch and status as styled prompt segments.
builtins.prompt-history: Returns the next history id as a styled prompt segment.
builtins.prompt-jobs: Returns the current background job count as a styled prompt segment.
builtins.prompt-newline: Inserts a line break in the prompt.
builtins.prompt-text: Returns literal text as a styled prompt segment.
builtins.prompt-time: Returns the current time as a styled prompt segment.
builtins.prompt-userhost: Returns the current user and host as a styled prompt segment.
builtins.ps: Lists running processes as Tosh process objects.
builtins.pwd: Returns the current directory as a DirectoryInfo object.
builtins.raise: Raises an event, invoking all registered handlers.
builtins.raw: Emits plain text without rich table or record rendering.
builtins.read-bytes: Reads one or more files and returns each file as a byte array.
builtins.read-file: Reads one or more files and returns each file as a single string value.
builtins.read-from: Reads a text or binary chunk from an open managed file handle.
builtins.read-line: Reads a line of text from standard input.
builtins.read-line-from: Reads the next text line from an open managed file handle.
builtins.read-lines: Reads one or more files and emits their contents line-by-line.
builtins.read-to-end: Reads the remainder of an open managed file handle.
builtins.reduce: Folds the current pipeline into one value using a seed and callable value or block.
builtins.replace: Replaces text in each input value.
builtins.reverse: Reverses the order of the current pipeline objects.
builtins.scan: Like reduce but yields every intermediate accumulator value.
builtins.seek: Moves an open managed file handle to a new position and returns the handle for continued piping.
builtins.select: Gets a member, projects fields, or retrieves an item by index.
builtins.set-prop: Sets or adds a property on a dynamic record.
builtins.signal: Sends a signal to a ToSh background job or operating-system process.
builtins.size-of: Returns the unmanaged size of a supported native interop type.
builtins.skip: Skips the first object or first N objects from the pipeline.
builtins.skip-until: Skips input values until the predicate becomes true.
builtins.skip-while: Skips input values while the predicate remains true.
builtins.split: Splits text values into smaller text values.
builtins.stat: Returns detailed metadata for one or more paths.
builtins.styled: Creates a styled text segment with color and formatting.
builtins.sum: Sums numeric, storage size, or timespan values.
builtins.summary: Computes structured summary objects for requested aggregates over the pipeline.
builtins.systemctl: Wraps systemctl, returning typed unit rows for supported list queries and structured unit property sets for supported show and status queries.
builtins.tail: Returns the last objects or last text lines.
builtins.take-until: Yields input values until the predicate becomes true.
builtins.take-while: Yields input values while the predicate remains true.
builtins.tee: Passes values through while also writing them out or capturing them.
builtins.tempfile: Creates a temporary file and returns it as a file system entry.
builtins.template: Renders pipeline objects into text using {{ member.path }} placeholders.
builtins.timespan: Parses a duration into a CLR duration value.
builtins.touch: Creates files or updates access and modification timestamps.
builtins.tr: Translates or deletes characters in text.
builtins.transpose: Pivots rows into columns. Each input record's keys become column headers and values become rows.
builtins.tree: Wraps the system tree utility, returning typed tree-entry objects.
builtins.tui: Interactive TUI components for scripts. Provides list pickers, confirmations, text input, file pickers, and custom screens. Use --cli for inline (non-fullscreen) prompts.
builtins.type-of: Returns the CLR type or ToSh class type for each input object.
builtins.types: Lists available CLR and ToSh shell types.
builtins.uname: Returns kernel and operating system information as a Tosh object.
builtins.unfold: Generates values from a seed by repeatedly applying a callable. The callable receives the current state and must return a [value, next-state] pair, or null to stop.
builtins.unset: Removes Tosh variables, functions, and exported environment names.
builtins.uptime: Returns system uptime and load averages.
builtins.vars: Lists all visible variables in the current scope.
builtins.view: Gets or sets shell display preferences.
builtins.wait-for: Waits for one or more ToSh background jobs to finish.
builtins.wc: Counts lines, words, bytes, characters, and longest-line length.
builtins.where: Filters pipeline objects with a predicate block or callable.
builtins.which: Resolves built-in commands and external executables.
builtins.window: Yields sliding windows of a given size over the pipeline.
builtins.write: Writes rendered values without a trailing newline.
builtins.write-bytes: Writes byte-oriented content to a file, replacing any previous contents.
builtins.write-file: Writes plain text to a file, replacing any previous contents.
builtins.write-line-to: Writes one or more text lines to an open managed text file handle.
builtins.write-to: Writes plain text or bytes to an open managed file handle.
builtins.writeline: Writes rendered values with a trailing newline.
builtins.xargs: Builds command invocations from text input.
builtins.zip: Merges two sequences pairwise. The second sequence is the first argument (an array).
